last.verdict: Investors cheered a big revenue beat and a $5 billion jump in the sales outlook.

reasons.label: Sales outlook raised sharply
reasons.text: 2026 revenue forecast lifted to $91–92 billion from $85–87 billion.

reasons.label: Obesity and diabetes drugs booming
reasons.text: Mounjaro sales rose 65% to $10.7 billion, Zepbound 49% to $5.35 billion.

reasons.label: New pill ramping, pipeline wins
reasons.text: Foundayo pill sold $184 million; retatrutide beat Ozempic in a head-to-head trial.

story: Lilly has beaten estimates and raised its sales forecast every quarter this year, led by Mounjaro and Zepbound. Revenue growth ran 56% in Q1 and 48% in Q2, then 39% in Q3. Shares rose after Q1 (reportedly about 10%). Heavy acquisition charges keep trimming profit forecasts.
